Uncrowned/Yahoo column on Gaethje's Sports Illustrated interview: both hands still hurt, will enjoy being champion for the rest of 2026, may weigh pros and cons of fighting again; what that means for Tsarukyan and the division

All eight quote the same Eze Talks Sports ringside interview in Dublin; #838 and #913 pad with Jon Anik's rematch claim as context, and #892 misattributes it to DAZN, but the news peg in each is Pimblett's 'smash his head in / nobody has spoken to me' remarks.

All eight are Q&A excerpts attributed to one NV sit-down ('у розмові з журналістом NV'), cross-linked to each other and published in pieces; nothing in the text shows a second sitting, so one interview stays one story.

The cluster mixes the fight result with two separate post-fight interviews (in-cage with Bisping, then backstage to UFC.com) and a Sport.ua next-day assessment column; #737's captured text does include the live result and play-by-play, so it stays with the result.

substories.description: Fight result: Donchenko beats Punahele Soriano by unanimous decision (30-27, 30-27, 29-28) on the UFC Paris (Fight Night 287) main card, his 4th UFC win, dropping him in round 1; includes event-wide results and live-blog pages listing the bout
In-cage octagon interview with Michael Bisping right after the win: Donchenko grabs the mic and calls out Daniel Rodriguez

Backstage post-fight interview with UFC.com: Donchenko elaborates the Rodriguez callout (end-of-year card or a five-round APEX fight), explains he did not rush off the ground because he knew he had won, 'living the American dream'
Sport.ua next-day analysis column: Donchenko dominated Soriano but could have done better and did not get the knockout; top-15 and five-round questions
